brief:
The Palestinian Meteorology Department predicted Friday would bring hot conditions in mountainous areas and extreme heat across the rest of the territory, Shehab Wire reported. Temperatures are expected to reach levels approximately 4 degrees Celsius above seasonal averages.

The forecast pointed to persistently high humidity levels accompanying the heat wave across Palestinian regions. The significant temperature spike marks a notable departure from typical weather patterns for the period.
